champions-league.label: UEFA Champions League / European Cup
champions-league.era_notes: Founded 1955 as the European Cup; rebranded UEFA Champions League in 1992-93.

europa-league.label: UEFA Europa League / UEFA Cup
europa-league.era_notes: UEFA Cup 1972-2009; rebranded UEFA Europa League in 2009-10.

conference-league.label: UEFA Conference League
conference-league.era_notes: UEFA's tertiary European club competition since 2021-22.

cup-winners-cup.label: UEFA Cup Winners' Cup
cup-winners-cup.era_notes: 1960-61 to 1998-99. Discontinued; merged into the UEFA Cup after the 1998-99 final.

inter-cities-fairs-cup.label: Inter-Cities Fairs Cup
inter-cities-fairs-cup.era_notes: 1955-1971. Predecessor to the UEFA Cup. Never officially recognized by UEFA as one of its competitions.

uefa-super-cup.label: UEFA Super Cup
uefa-super-cup.era_notes: Annual one-match final between the UEFA Champions League and UEFA Europa League winners.

club-world-cup.label: FIFA Club World Cup / Intercontinental Cup
club-world-cup.era_notes: Intercontinental Cup 1960-2004; FIFA Club World Cup since 2000. The two competitions overlapped, then merged after 2004 into a unified FIFA tournament.

copa-libertadores.label: Copa Libertadores
copa-libertadores.era_notes: CONMEBOL's premier club competition, contested since 1960. South America's counterpart to the European Cup / Champions League.

other-continental.label: Other Continental Tournaments
other-continental.era_notes: The premier club competitions of the other four confederations: CONCACAF (North America), CAF (Africa), AFC (Asia), and OFC (Oceania).
